(Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer readable medium having stored thereon comprising computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information __and the associated recipient data__; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.
